tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Social Mobility- Education vs Economic Policy
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: This semester, we are exploring the concept of social mobility. Social mobility refers to the ability of individuals or families to move up or down the social ladder over time, especially by growing wealthier. Some sociologists argue that education is the key to improving social mobility, while others believe that economic policies and government intervention play a larger role. What do you think is the most effective way to enhance social mobility? Why?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I think education is the most effective way to enhance social mobility. Access to quality education provides individuals with the knowledge and skills needed to pursue better job opportunities and improve their socioeconomic status. Without education, people are unlikely to become wealthier.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe economic policies and government intervention are more effective at helping people to improve their economic and social status. Policies that address income inequality, provide financial support, and create job opportunities can significantly impact social mobility and help individuals rise out of poverty.
